description: This file defines a mixin class for optimizing API responses related to 'custom_tags' in a web application, specifically for frontend compatibility and SQL query reduction in the Apache Superset project.

classes.name: CustomTagsOptimizationMixin
classes.description: A reusable mixin class for APIs that optimize tag queries via custom_tags relationship, providing frontend compatibility and SQL query reduction.

methods.name: _setup_custom_tags_optimization
methods.description: Configures whether to use custom_tags only based on application config and sets the list columns accordingly.

methods.name: get_list
methods.description: Overrides the default get_list method to rewrite request parameters for custom_tags optimization when enabled.

methods.name: pre_get_list
methods.description: Post-processes the response data to rename 'custom_tags' back to 'tags' for frontend compatibility.
